transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to discuss the closing screening's interactive musical finale. Before I can give my binding approval on the operating package, I need to hear the standard pre-opening production review — specifically the reports from our technical and rights clearance teams. The draft package calls for audience members to use handheld wireless microphones, sing along to four selected songs, and read projected lyrics. Can I get those reports started?

transcript.text: I need to report a critical technical finding from yesterday's full-site rehearsal. I completed an RF survey and found that audience handheld microphones interfere with the emergency-communications channel. The approved workaround is a host-led call-and-response using exactly two wired microphones. I should note my written survey has not yet been filed with the event office, but the finding is confirmed and the workaround is approved. This directly affects the draft package's plan for audience members to use handheld wireless microphones.
